title: Floral Bible Verse Bookmark Set
author: Nann Digital Art
description:
Inspirational Scripture Bookmarks, 12 Floral Bible Verse Printables, Faith Encouragement Gift for Christian Women
Twelve Inspiring Reminders to Walk in Faith and Rest in God’s Word
Let every page bring your heart back to God’s promises. This uplifting collection includes 12 Printable Scripture Bookmarks created to offer faith, hope, peace, and encouragement throughout your day.
Each bookmark measures 2.5×7.5 inches and features a Bible verse surrounded by beautiful floral artwork. The set includes 15 printable pages formatted for A4 and US Letter paper, ready for convenient home printing.
These bookmarks are perfect for personal devotion, encouragement gifts, Bible-loving friends, Christian women, care packages, prayer groups, and church communities. Keep the full collection for yourself or print and share individual bookmarks with people who need a gentle reminder of God’s love.
Digital download only. No physical product is included.
ITEM DESCRIPTION:
 This is a printable digital download. No physical items will be shipped. You can print these images as many times as you need.
You will receive 1 ZIP: JPG, PNG, PDF
 – JPG file with set of twelve bookmarks images on it, 2.5″ x 7.5″ in size each on it.
 – PNG file with transparent background set of twelve bookmarks images on it, 2.5″ x 7.5″ in size each on it.
 – PDF file with twelve bookmarks, 2.5″ x 7.5″ in size each and the same twelve images in separate.
 – Fits standard paper size US letter/ A4 when printing. Total fifteen printing paper pad
 – one side
 – They are all the same layer and CANNOT BE EDITABLE!
 – High resolution 300dpi for the finest printing results.
PLEASE NOTE:
 – Colors may vary slightly depending on the monitor.
INSTANT DOWNLOAD:
 You can print these designs unlimited times. Moreover, you can use it to be a digital decor paper with your digital planner too!
